newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Bondi Christmas party avoids last year's violence.
newsitem.headline: Bondi Christmas party avoids last year's violence.

text.p: Christmas day revellers at Sydney's Bondi Beach partied under the sun on Wednesday, avoiding a repeat of last year's riot by hundreds of out-of-towners.
But high surf and high winds kept the lifeguards busy with about 100 rescues on an otherwise trouble-free day.
Police estimated 10,000 people congregated on Australia's most famous beach under the watchful eye of police and security guards until rain dispersed the crowd of mostly overseas backpackers.
Police in riot gear clashed with youths last year when drunken crowds attacked cars, prompting the local council to announce an organised, ticketed Christmas party this year.
